senses.gloss: (v. כְּרַהּ a. כָּרַךְ) to be tied, narrowed in.—Denom. כֹּרַח.

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 75">Gen. R. s. 75</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>הכריעהו</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 17:13">Ps. XVII, 13</cite>) <he>הַכְרִיחֵהוּ וכ׳</he> force him down on the scale of guilt, break his resistance; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 130:17">Yalk. Gen. 130</cite> <he>הכריעהו</he>).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:12">Cant. R. to IV, 12</cite> <he>אם בנפשותן הן מַכְרִיחִין וכ׳</he> (not <he>בעשותן</he>) if they did violence to their souls, how much more &c.; (Pesik. B’shall. p. 82ᵇ <he>שליטין</he>).
